description: FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE(file-connector-name) with an optional file-connector-name argument (ISO §2023:15.28.2/.3/.4 r2) — a COBOL-2023 addition (Annex E.3.3 item 25): it returns the NAMED FD connector's I-O status + SELECT-spelled name, or two spaces if that connector was never opened/attempted/accessed. The no-argument base form is 2002. The argument form is gated below 2023.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. EXCFA.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO "excfa.txt".
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 R PIC X(5).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 W PIC X(20).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           MOVE FUNCTION EXCEPTION-FILE(F) TO W.
           DISPLAY W.
           STOP RUN.
